convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorZerolagX10MA indicator and includes external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing and trade execution logic

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars needed for indicator warmup
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: Signal timestamp calculation for trade functions

other_exits: Buy positions closed on bearish signal reversal when BuyPosClose=true
Sell positions closed on bullish signal reversal when SellPosClose=true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum: LOT=fixed lot size, BALANCE=fraction of balance, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin less loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance less loss. MM=0.1 interpreted based on MMMode

custom_logic_notes: Signal logic: Reads 3 values from ColorZerolagX10MA buffer 0 starting at SignalBar. Value[0]=bar SignalBar, Value[1]=bar SignalBar+1, Value[2]=bar SignalBar+2. Bullish signal when Value[1]<Value[2] (trend turning up) AND Value[0]>Value[1] (confirmed continuation) - opens buy, closes sell. Bearish signal when Value[1]>Value[2] (trend turning down) AND Value[0]<Value[1] (confirmed continuation) - opens sell, closes buy. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose input booleans gate each action independently. If SignalBar==0, signals are evaluated every tick instead of only on new bars. Recount flag triggers re-evaluation after CopyBuffer failures. Trade functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) are from TradeAlgorithms.mqh library.
python_conversion_notes: The ColorZerolagX10MA is a custom indicator that must be reimplemented in Python. It is a zero-lag composite of 10 moving averages (JJMA default) with weighted factors, further smoothed by SMA. The smoothing algorithms (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh must all be ported. The trade execution helpers from TradeAlgorithms.mqh (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar) must also be reimplemented. MarginMode-based position sizing logic needs careful translation. Signal logic uses 3-bar lookback comparison of the indicator line to detect trend direction changes. SL/TP values (1000/2000) appear to be in points and may need 5-digit broker adjustment (multiply by 10 if _Digits==5).
